name: Solar Swarm Belt
description: An asteroid belt of glowing particles on a flattened ellipse around a hot core — drawn on canvas

variations.name: default
variations.description: Seventy-odd particles each carry their own speed, radius and ellipse, so the belt never resolves into a visible pattern

props.name: size
props.description: Overall size of the 3D scene in pixels

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the star at the centre of the scene

props.name: count
props.description: Number of particles in the belt

props.name: flatten
props.description: Height of the belt as a percentage of its width

props.name: withButton
props.description: Wraps the scene in the AI-agent "Thinking" button shell

props.name: label
props.description: Shimmering text shown beside the loader in the button shell
